title: Qualify immutable Standard Expression and Quantities NuGet closure in independent net11 binary consumer
commitMessage: test: qualify published Math Standard binaries on net11

contribution.summary: Verify the three-package published Standard-Expression-Quantities closure under SDK11/net11 with the original independent ten-check binary fixture.
contribution.value: Read-only SHA-256 validation of three published archives and DLLs from NUGET_LOCAL, exact Standard PackageReference in an isolated net11/C#15 consumer, execution of the RS143 ten-check fixture, and archive rehash after the run. No publication or production migration.
debtChanges: RS247 succeeded first-pass attempt 001 for published Expression and Quantities binary dependency closure under net11.
RS248 extends package-only evidence to Standard and its two exact dependencies, but does not certify Linux Standard consumption, entire Math graph or M8 completion.
contribution.nextAction: Qualify the published Standard dependency closure in a source-free Linux WSL net11 consumer and continue the .NET11 migration risk gates.
